title: Live ClickHouse latency check — 2026-09-29
summary: Read-only timings of the SQL in open cbioportal-mcp PRs #151, #154 and #160 (not merged or deployed) on the current public DB. #160 saves 0.24–0.60 s per call (median 0.29 s, identical results); #154 fallback SQL takes 0.08–1.35 s vs an estimated ~3–4 ms lookup; #151 schema calls cost 1.4–2.6 ms. DB share of answer latency not measured.
